touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Holywell qualifies as a local detour through St Winefride's Well and Groes Omen Windmill. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Holywell: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Holywell offers St Winefride's Well, Groes Omen Windmill, Parish Church of St. James within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
